findings.explanation: RepsConfigViewSet.get_queryset returns RepsConfig.objects.all() with no user filter, unlike the sibling viewsets (WeightConfig, MaxWeightConfig, SetsConfig, etc.) which filter by slot_config__slot__day__routine__user=self.request.user. The viewset is marked is_private=True (so WgerPermission.has_permission only requires authentication, not ownership) and is registered at the public router (wger/urls.py). WgerPermission.has_object_permission relies on obj.get_owner_object().user == request.user, but the queryset is unfiltered, so any authenticated user can list and retrieve RepsConfig objects belonging to other users via the reps-config endpoint. This is a newly introduced IDOR.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter the queryset by the requesting user, consistent with the other config viewsets: return RepsConfig.objects.filter(slot_config__slot__day__routine__user=self.request.user).
